title: An arithmetic evaluator, from its grammar
about: Write a recursive-descent evaluator for + - * / ^, unary minus and parentheses to a grammar in the header, with the errors it names.
task: Implement evaluate() in expr.cpp to the specification in expr.hpp: the grammar, the precedence and the errors it describes. `make test` builds and runs the tests. Do not edit anything under tests/ or the Makefile. Stop when `make test` passes and the implementation follows the whole specification.
hidden: mkdir -p build && g++ -std=c++17 -Wall -Wextra -g -fsanitize=address,undefined -I. -Itests -o build/hidden tests/test_expr_hidden.cpp expr.cpp && ./build/hidden
